SELECT *,ROUND(debit_total/debitQuantity) debitPrice,ROUND(credit_total/creditQuantity,2)creditPrice from ( SELECT bv.year_period,bv.voucher_date,bv.voucher_code,bv.voucher_id,bvr.summary, IFNULL(SUM(IF(bvr.balance_direction='DEBIT',bvr.quantity,0)),0) debitQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(IF(bvr.balance_direction='CREDIT',bvr.quantity,0)),0) creditQuantity, IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0) debit_total,IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0) credit_total FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{bookId} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId} and book_id = #{bookId}) ,'%') and bvr.price is not null and bvr.quantity is not null and bv.year_period = #{currentPeriod}
GROUP BY bv. year_period,bv.voucher_date,bv.voucher_code,bv.voucher_id,bvr.summary ) a

SELECT '期初余额'summary,SUM(bsp.period_end_balance) balance from book_subject_period bsp LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bsp.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId} and book_id = #{bookId}) ,'%') and bsp.year_period = #{currentPeriod} and bs.is_quantity = 1 and bs.is_leaf = 1
